edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller.

2. Closing. Subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to Closing set forth in this Agreement, Closing shall occur within 30 days after the date of this Agreement, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing.

3. Representations. The Seller represents that, to the Seller’s knowledge, the financial statements delivered to the Buyer are accurate in all material respects as of their respective dates, subject to the matters fairly disclosed in those financial statements.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and the other party’s confidential information, and shall not disclose such information except to its representatives who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations, as required by law or legal process, or with the other party’s written consent. This clause does not restrict disclosures of information that is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement.

Clarify that a party may make legally required disclosures after giving notice where legally permitted.

edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller, subject to adjustment for Company indebtedness, Company cash, unpaid transaction expenses, and working capital relative to a target working-capital amount, in each case as of Closing and calculated in accordance with accounting principles and procedures, and a target amount, to be mutually agreed by the parties and set forth in this Agreement. The parties shall cooperate in good faith to prepare and resolve any closing statement in accordance with procedures to be agreed in this Agreement. At Closing, USD 2,250,000 of the otherwise payable consideration shall be deposited with an escrow agent under an escrow agreement mutually agreed by the parties, to secure the Seller’s indemnification obligations, and shall be released to the Seller 12 months after Closing, less any amounts subject to a timely, good-faith claim made in accordance with the escrow agreement. The escrow shall be the Buyer’s sole source of recovery for indemnification claims, subject to the agreed terms of this Agreement.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 30 days after the date of this Agreement, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing, subject to satisfaction or waiver by the party for whose benefit the applicable condition exists of the following conditions: (a) completion by the Buyer, no later than 30 days after the date of this Agreement, of its confirmatory due diligence, with no material issue identified that would reasonably be expected to prevent the Buyer from consummating the transactions contemplated by this Agreement; (b) receipt of all required governmental and other third-party approvals; and (c) the other customary conditions expressly set forth in this Agreement. Any condition requiring a party’s satisfaction shall be applied reasonably and in good faith. If Closing has not occurred by the date that is 60 days after the date of this Agreement (the “Outside Date”), either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice to the other party, provided that a party may not terminate under this sentence if its material breach of this Agreement was the primary cause of the failure to close by the Outside Date. The parties may extend the Outside Date by written agreement.

3. Representations and Indemnification. The Seller represents that, except as specifically and fairly disclosed in the disclosure schedule delivered by the Seller to the Buyer in connection with this Agreement (the “Disclosure Schedule”), (a) the Seller has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, and (b) to the Seller’s knowledge, the financial statements of the Company delivered to the Buyer were prepared in accordance with the accounting principles stated therein and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial condition and results of operations of the Company as of the dates and for the periods indicated therein. The Seller makes no representation or warranty except as expressly set forth in this Agreement. The Buyer’s remedy for a breach of the Seller’s representations shall be indemnification subject to the limitations, procedures, thresholds, caps, survival periods, and exclusive-remedy provisions to be set forth in this Agreement, including recovery solely from the escrow for such claims. The parties shall negotiate customary indemnification provisions consistent with these limitations.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and the other party’s confidential information, and shall not disclose such information except to its representatives who need to know it and are bound by confidentiality obligations, as required by law or legal process, or with the other party’s written consent. This clause does not restrict disclosures of information that is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement, was already known to the receiving party without a duty of confidentiality, is independently developed without use of or reference to the disclosing party’s confidential information, or is lawfully received from another source not, to the receiving party’s knowledge, under a duty to keep it confidential. The Buyer may disclose confidential information to its actual and prospective financing sources and their representatives, in each case solely for purposes of the transaction and subject to confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this clause. A party required by law or legal process to disclose confidential information may do so, and shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt prior notice and reasonably cooperate, at the other party’s expense, in seeking to limit the disclosure.

receiver.private_reasoning: The Seller has expressly rejected USD 35 million but has not disclosed a bottom line. To avoid bidding against ourselves, maintain USD 35 million as the Buyer’s proposed price, subject to diligence and definitive terms, while making clear that any movement would depend on the diligence findings and agreed risk allocation. The draft’s adjustment mechanics, narrow representations, sole-recourse escrow, and limited diligence condition require substantial revision.
receiver.observed_irregularities: No comments, tracked changes, hidden text, or unusual metadata indicating an inadvertent disclosure were identified. The document properties appear to contain ordinary drafting and file information.
receiver.requested_changes: Please revise the draft to reflect the following Buyer positions: (1) Purchase price: USD 35,000,000, subject to customary closing adjustments for indebtedness, cash, transaction expenses, and working capital against a specified target. The agreement should include detailed accounting policies, preparation and review procedures, objection and dispute-resolution mechanics, and no double counting. (2) Escrow and indemnification: USD 2,250,000 for 12 months is not agreed. The escrow amount, duration, and release mechanics remain open; the escrow must not be the Buyer’s sole source of recovery. Include customary representations and warranties, covenants, specific indemnities where appropriate, and negotiated caps, baskets, survival periods, and fraud carve-outs. (3) Representations: Expand the Seller’s representations to cover, at minimum, the Company’s organization, authority, capitalization, financial statements, absence of undisclosed liabilities, taxes, material contracts, compliance with law, litigation, employees, and title to assets, subject to appropriately negotiated disclosure schedules and qualifiers. (4) Closing: The Buyer’s confirmatory diligence condition must permit the Buyer to assess the Company and terminate if diligence is unsatisfactory, in the Buyer’s reasonable judgment. Extend the diligence period and Outside Date as needed to permit completion of diligence and receipt of approvals. (5) Confidentiality: Retain the financing-source disclosure permission and add customary provisions for compelled disclosure, enforcement, and return or destruction of confidential information.
receiver.message_back: Thank you. We note the Seller’s position on price. The Buyer is not prepared to increase its USD 35,000,000 proposal on the present record. That proposal remains subject to satisfactory confirmatory diligence, customary purchase-price adjustments, and definitive terms providing an appropriate allocation of risk. The draft’s adjustment, representation, indemnification, escrow, and diligence provisions are not agreed; please circulate a revised draft addressing the points above. We remain willing to discuss transaction structure and the open terms.
